content:
Overview

Gimhae is a city in GSN with a population of 550,000. A historic city near Busan, known as the cradle of the Gaya Confederacy and home to Gimhae International Airport. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
